source: Electricity: EIA State Electricity Profiles, data year 2024 (released November 10, 2025), carbon dioxide emission rate of power generated in the state: Illinois 510 lbs/MWh (0.2313 kg/kWh), United States 785 lbs/MWh (0.3561 kg/kWh). These are CO2 only (not CO2e) and describe in-state generation; Illinois is nuclear-heavy and the grid serving a Chicago building (EPA eGRID subregion) may be higher, so treat carbon results as estimates. Gas: about 53.06 kg CO2 per MMBtu (about 5.31 kg per therm) from the EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub, to be verified. Not verified carbon accounting.
